content.heading: Lumière
content.description: Experience invisible excellence at our flagship dining room in Mayfair.

content.heading: A sanctuary of light and culinary precision.
content.description: At Lumière, we believe the finest dining experiences are those where the service is felt but not seen. Every dish is a dialogue between tradition and innovation, meticulously crafted to showcase the purest essence of seasonal ingredients.
content.quote: The intersection of high-end hospitality and technical precision.
content.chefQuote: Culinary art is not found in complexity, but in the radical simplification of a flavor until its soul is revealed. At Lumière, we strip away the noise to let the ingredient speak.
content.chefBio: With three Michelin stars and a career spanning the finest kitchens of Lyon and Paris, Chef Vignon brings a technical rigor to Mayfair that is unmatched. Her vision for Lumière was to create a space where diners could lose track of time, anchored only by the rhythm of the season.

content.heading: Featured Dishes
content.description: A curated selection from our kitchen, chosen by Chef Vignon.

content.heading: The Lumière Gallery
content.description: Captured moments of invisible excellence

images.caption: Private dining vault featuring mahogany table and hand-blown amber chandelier.
Vintage premier grand cru classé poured into thin-stemmed crystal.
Deconstructed chocolate sphere with gold leaf on dark slate plate.
Precision garnish placement in our surgical kitchen environment.
Panoramic golden hour lighting across soaring ceilings and crisp linens.

content.heading: Special Offers
content.description: Seasonal promotions from the kitchen and cellar.

testimonials.quote: The most refined dining experience in Mayfair - every detail considered.
Chef Vignon’s tasting menu is a masterclass in restraint and flavor.
Impeccable service and a wine list to match. Our go-to for anniversaries.

content.heading: Sloane & Co. Salon
content.description: Expert cuts, lived-in color, flawless nails and glowing skin - book your stylist online in under a minute.

content.heading: Great hair, zero attitude.
content.description: Sloane & Co. is a full-service salon on South Lamar - hair, color, nails and skin under one roof. Every visit starts with a real consultation, so you leave with a look that fits your life, not just your feed.
content.quote: You should feel like the best version of you when you walk out our door.
content.chefQuote: I opened Sloane & Co. to build the salon I always wanted to work in - warm, inclusive and obsessed with the details.
content.chefBio: A licensed cosmetologist with 15 years behind the chair in Dallas and Los Angeles, Sloane opened her Austin studio in 2018. Today her team of 12 stylists, nail artists and estheticians looks after more than 4,000 guests a year.

content.heading: Signature Services
content.description: The appointments our guests book again and again.

content.heading: Fresh From the Chair
content.description: Real guests, real results - follow along @sloaneandco.

content.description: A little extra for new and returning guests.

Finally a salon that really knows curly hair. My curl cut was life-changing.
Booked online in two minutes, got a mimosa and the cutest gel mani. Obsessed.

content.heading: Fernwood Coffee Co.
content.description: Small-batch roasted coffee, fresh-baked pastries and a room built for staying a while - order ahead for pickup.

content.heading: Good coffee, made for staying a while.
content.description: Fernwood Coffee Co. roasts small batches every week and pours them in a room built for lingering - laptops, book clubs and long catch-ups all welcome.
content.quote: A great cup starts with the beans, but a great cafe is built on the room around it.
content.chefQuote: I wanted a shop where the barista remembers your order and nobody rushes you out the door.
content.chefBio: A former line cook turned coffee obsessive, Owen opened Fernwood in Fremont in 2017 after two years of pulling shots on weekends to learn the craft. The shop now roasts its own house blend on-site every week.

content.heading: Customer Favorites
content.description: What our regulars order on repeat.

content.heading: Life at Fernwood
content.description: Regulars, laptops, and a lot of coffee - every day of the week.

content.heading: Current Offers
content.description: A little something extra for new and regular faces.

testimonials.quote: My order is ready by the time I get to the counter. Best mobile ordering of any shop in the neighborhood.
The pour-over program is legit - always a different, well-explained single-origin on the board.
I work from here twice a week. Good wifi, better cinnamon rolls, and nobody ever rushes you out.

content.heading: Brightside Laundry Co.
content.description: Dry cleaning, wash & fold and alterations - all cleaned in-house, with free pickup and delivery on every order over $35.

content.heading: Laundry day, handled with care.
content.description: Brightside Laundry Co. is a family-owned laundry and dry cleaner in Park Slope - every order is cleaned in-house, never outsourced, with free pickup and delivery on top.
content.quote: We treat every order like it is going to our own family - because for 20 years, it has been.
content.chefQuote: My parents opened this shop so neighbors could trust exactly who was cleaning their clothes. Twenty years later, that is still the whole business.
content.chefBio: Maria grew up folding towels behind the counter of her parents' laundromat. She took over in 2014, added dry cleaning and free pickup and delivery, and now runs the shop with a team of 14 across two Brooklyn locations.

content.heading: Popular Services
content.description: What our neighbors send us most.

content.heading: A Look Inside Brightside
content.description: Every order, washed, pressed and folded in-house.

content.heading: Current Offers
content.description: A little extra for new and returning neighbors.

testimonials.quote: Free pickup and delivery changed my life. Everything comes back folded better than I could ever do it.
They saved my wedding suit after a wine spill the night before. Genuinely grateful.
Same-day wash and fold has been a lifesaver with two kids. Never going back to doing it myself.
